entities.name: PMID:25433496
observations: Primary study in Cell Communication and Signaling (2014) investigating Brachyury in renal tubular EMT and fibrosis.
In TGF-β1-treated human proximal tubular HK-2 cells, Brachyury induction accompanied EMT; siRNA blockade reversed the EMT phenotype.
Brachyury induction repressed E-cadherin transcription; promoter-reporter experiments identified a Brachyury binding site, with partial mediation by Slug and Snail.
Brachyury was detected in rat obstructive nephropathy and IgA-nephropathy tubulointerstitial fibrosis tissues.

entities.name: Brachyury/TBXT
observations: T-box transcription factor induced by TGF-β1 in HK-2 renal proximal tubular epithelial cells.
siRNA inhibition reversed TGF-β1-induced EMT; overexpression reduced E-cadherin reporter activity.
Detected in rat obstructive nephropathy and IgA-nephropathy tubulointerstitial fibrosis tissue.

entities.name: E-cadherin/CDH1
observations: Brachyury induction repressed E-cadherin transcription in HK-2 cells; the E-cadherin promoter contains a Brachyury binding site.
Slug and Snail knockdown partially restored E-cadherin expression during Brachyury-mediated EMT.

entities.name: Renal interstitial fibrosis
observations: Brachyury expression was observed in rat obstructive nephropathy and tubulointerstitial fibrosis tissues from IgA nephropathy, supporting an in-vivo association with renal fibrosis.
